title: Paperboat workspace policy
description: Who may use what on which machines of one workspace. Rules allow or deny; a deny wins over an allow; anything no rule allows is denied. The owner of a personal machine always keeps access to it. Reference: shared/policy/README.md.

$schema.description: Optional; editors use it for completion.

allow_private_access.description: Team workspaces only. When false (the default), no rule gives private_access.

groups.description: Named sets of members, used in src.

subject.description: user:<email>, group:<name>, role:owner, role:admin (owners and admins), role:billing, role:auditor (exact role), role:member (everyone) or * (every member).

target.description: machine:<alias>, machine:*, tag:<name>, preview:<name>, tunnel:<name> or env:team. One rule's dst is all machines/tags, all previews/tunnels, or env:team.

action.description: Machine actions (machine:, tag:): terminal, exec, managed_ssh, files, preview_manage, tunnel_manage, private_access, inspect, replay, or * for all of them. Preview/tunnel actions: inspect, replay. ENV actions (env:team): env_read, env_write.

port.description: A port (5432) or an inclusive range ("8000-8100").

ports.description: Only with allow or deny exactly ["private_access"]. Default: an allow covers 1024-65535, a deny every port.
